mechanism.claim: Within a completed high-variation BTC path, the normalized lagged product of each five-minute return with the next return squared identifies which signed shocks systematically propagate into subsequent activity. A new upper-tail absolute propagation state should continue in the feedback sign for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the signed return-to-next-variance feedback score
mechanism.why_distinct: Realized-skew candidates sum contemporaneous return cubes; HVSAR correlates adjacent signed returns; HAR and VoV candidates forecast variation magnitude; HVRSSR estimates negative covariance and fades total displacement. HVSVF uses a directional lag operator from signed return r_t to unsigned next-interval energy r_(t+1)^2, reusing no event set or control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily onset opportunities based on a lagged third-order path functional are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_aggregation: 96 exact left-labeled groups of five consecutive rows; OHLC first/max/min/last
features.five_minute_returns: 95 close-to-close natural-log returns from aggregated closes
features.feedback_numerator: sum over t=1..94 of r_t * r_(t+1)^2
features.feedback_denominator: sqrt(sum r_t^2 * sum r_(t+1)^4), finite strict positive
features.feedback_score: numerator/denominator, finite in [-1,1] and strict nonzero
features.feedback_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(feedback_score) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.realized_variation: sum squared 95 five-minute returns, finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no window, functional, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
